name: Aroche (Spain)
description: Five vertical stripes of red and white crossed by a blue bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aroche (a castle on white, and castles and lions).
history: Municipal flag of Aroche; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
